subject: Sampling from INLA for Cox process

messages.author: 90f9727a090f234d
messages.subject: Sampling from INLA for Cox process
parts:
Hi,

I am following the example in Section 4.1 in the Chapter 4 on Log-Cox point process of the tutorial in https://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/tutorials/spde/html/

How does one draw realizations from an object (say, pp) of class inla trained using family='poisson'?
In other words, how do I extract data on Z(s) (or lambda(s)) from samples produced by:
samples <- inla.posterior.sample(nsamp,pp)

Kind regards,
Devaraj.

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Sampling from INLA for Cox process
parts:
Extracting lambda(s) is the same as extracting the posterior predictive surface (posterior median/mean fitted values) in any spatial model.

To learn more about the samples you get, see
https://haakonbakka.bitbucket.io/btopic112.html#51_the_structure_of_the_samples

Haakon
